## RSYC R package

::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}
- Distributes the full RSYC model catalogue (AGB & volume; tiles & ecological strata)
- Consistent interface – same call for any species, attribute and spatial level
- Discover which models are available, predict by age, calibrate with local observations
- Build curve datasets joined to spatial boundaries (GeoPackage export)
- Model parameters also available as plain CSV – usable outside R

```r
remotes::install_github("ptompalski/RSYC")
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%" .fn-table}
| Task | Functions |
|:--|:--|
| Predict & build datasets | `predict_rsyc()`<br>`calibrate_rsyc()`<br>`build_rsyc_dataset()` |
| Discover models | `available_rsyc_models()`<br>`rsyc_species()`<br>`rsyc_strata()`<br>`species_codes()` |
| Spatial boundaries | `rsyc_boundaries()`<br>`download_rsyc_boundaries()` |
| Data | `RSYC_models` |

[ptompalski.github.io/RSYC](https://ptompalski.github.io/RSYC)
:::
:::

## RSYC R package – examples

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Which models are available?**

```r
available_rsyc_models(
  response = "volume",
  species = "PICE.GLA",
  strata_level = "ecoregion"
)
```

```text
# A tibble: 74 × 11  (selected columns shown)
  strata_name              strata_code species  model_version
1 Appalachians             117         PICE.GLA v20260923
2 Northern New Brunswick … 118         PICE.GLA v20260923
3 Annapolis-Minas Lowlands 126         PICE.GLA v20260923
4 Atlantic Coast           125         PICE.GLA v20260923
5 Cape Breton Highlands    129         PICE.GLA v20260923
# ℹ 69 more rows
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
**Predict volume by age**

```r
predict_rsyc(
  response = "volume",
  species = "PICE.MAR",
  age = c(20, 40, 80, 100, 120),
  strata_level = "ecodistrict",
  strata_id = 522
)
```

```text
[1]  31.54869  62.33402  92.98444  99.94032 104.56767
```

Black spruce, ecodistrict 522 (Ainslie Uplands); m³ ha⁻¹
:::
:::

## Model updates & versioning

::: columns
::: {.column width="60%"}
- Models updated on a **two-year cycle**, matching the NTEMS updates (new AGB, age and species time series)
- Each release is explicitly versioned (e.g., `v20260709` → `v20260923`)
  - `model_version` stored with every curve and in generated dataset metadata
  - stable `model_id` for every curve
- Release notes document changes in coefficients and coverage
- Parameters distributed as CSV with a checksum manifest; spatial boundaries versioned separately
- Record `model_id` and `model_version` with any RSYC-derived product
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}
**Current release: `v20260923`**

- 27,208 curves
- corrected ecodistrict sampling
- ecological models limited to the 12 forested ecozones
- new numeric ecological strata codes (`strata_code`)
:::
:::
